slides.headline: 6 EXPENSIVE PROBLEMS ONE AI PROMPT JUST FIXED
1) FIGHT A MEDICAL BILL
slides.body: A $1,200 hospital bill got cut to $180 after one paste. 'Here is my medical bill. Find every inflated charge and draft a dispute letter with fair price comparisons'

slides.headline: 2) SELL YOUR STUFF WITHOUT THE BACK AND FORTH
slides.body: AI prices your items, writes every listing, and replies to lowball offers for you. 'Here are photos of 5 things I want to sell. Price each one, write a listing, and handle negotiations'

slides.headline: 3) REHEARSE A JOB INTERVIEW UNTIL YOU NAIL IT
slides.body: He ran mock rounds with Claude. Got ripped for rambling. Fixed it. Got the job. 'Here's the job posting and my background. Run interview rounds one question at a time and critique each answer'

slides.headline: 4) REDESIGN A ROOM FOR UNDER $500
slides.body: One photo of your living room gets a full redesign plus a shopping list under $500. 'Redesign this room in modern minimalist style and give me a shopping list under $500 with store names'

slides.headline: 5) PREDICT EVERY QUESTION YOUR BOSS WILL ASK
slides.body: An analyst ran this before every meeting. The room felt scripted. 'You're a skeptical boss reading this summary. List the 5 hardest questions you'd ask and what data would answer each'

slides.headline: 6) CATCH LIES IN ANYTHING AI WROTE FOR YOU
slides.body: A researcher stopped trusting AI summaries. This catches the gaps. 'Read this. Flag every claim with no proof, rate how confident you are of each, and list what's missing'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS POST
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when the problem hits. Save it now. Daily AI news and real skills you can use tonight

caption:
Swipe for 6 prompts that solved real problems for real people this month, from a $1,200 bill to a job offer 🔥

Fighting medical bills with AI dispute letters, selling old stuff where AI prices and haggles for you, rehearsing job interviews with brutal mock rounds, redesigning any room from one phone photo with a shopping list under $500, predicting every hardball question your boss will ask before a meeting, and catching weak claims in anything AI writes before your name goes on it

People stopped asking AI to write essays and started handing it problems that used to cost real money. The prompts are short. The results are not.
